subject: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Patel <anya@fintechlab.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-01T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check

Hi Anya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we want to schedule a 45–60 minute discovery that includes:
- Product brief (AE) — business outcomes / use cases you care about
- Technical fit (SE) — architecture, data flows, security constraints
- Procurement / security Qs — quick intake so we can surface any evidence requests before a pilot

Attendees we suggest: you (champion), your engineering lead (Liam), procurement/security leads (if you have them), Ben (SE) and me (AE). Can you share a few 1-hour windows that work for the week of Dec 4 (PST)? We can compress to 45 minutes if we need to keep procurement off the call.

Proposed:
- Tue 2028-12-05 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-12-06 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2028-12-07 09:00–10:00 PT

We also have a short evidence checklist I can share ahead of time (SOC2, retention, isolation). I attached a one-pager and a draft SOW outline for context.

If none of those work, tell us two slots and we’ll try to match.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (outline), security-evidence-onepager.pdf (summary)

From: Anya Patel <anya@fintechlab.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nebula.tech>, Procurement <procurement@fintechlab.com>, Security Team <security@fintechlab.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-01T18:21:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check

Mina —

Appreciate the note. Quick constraints from our side:
- Liam (eng lead) is in EMEA next week and only available late-morning ET / early afternoon PT.
- Procurement has a monthly review on Dec 5 and prefers not to be on many vendor calls that day.
- Security would like the checklist ahead of time if possible (they’ll triage asynchronously).

Suggested slots that keep most people present:
- Wed 2028-12-06 13:00–14:00 PT (Liam can join remotely)
- Thu 2028-12-07 11:00–11:45 PT (procurement prefers shorter)

I’ll loop in procurement (procurement@fintechlab.com) and security (security@fintechlab.com) here so they can confirm. If we want to do a two-step flow (discovery with AE+SE+champion, then separate procurement/security session), we can do that too.

—Anya
Anya Patel | Head of Product, FinTech Lab
anya@fintechlab.com | +1 646-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Patel <anya@fintechlab.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nebula.tech>
Date: 2028-12-02T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check

Anya / Mina —

Thanks for the options. A couple of small asks from engineering:
- If we do Wed 12/06 at 13:00 PT, that’s 16:00 ET / 21:00 GMT for Liam — still workable but would prefer earlier for him.
- Thu 12/07 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET is also fine and aligns with procurement’s ask for a shorter slot.

Two practical proposals:
A) Do the 45-minute discovery on Thu 2028-12-07 11:00–11:45 PT (we keep procurement + security on the tail end for 10–15 mins)
B) Do a 60-minute discovery on Wed 2028-12-06 12:30–13:30 PT so Liam has an earlier local time (19:30 GMT) and procurement can skip if needed; we follow up with a 30-minute procurement/security-only sync the next day.

I’ll add a short technical agenda: model integration surface (ingest, size, latency expectations), data residency and retention, pilot success metrics, and next steps.

Proposed calendar links:
- Option A (45m): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=optA-fintech
- Option B (60m): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=optB-fintech

Which do you prefer? I can send invites once we lock.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Procurement <procurement@fintechlab.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Anya Patel <anya@fintechlab.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@fintechlab.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nebula.tech>
Date: 2028-12-02T10:11:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check

Hi team —

Quick note from procurement/security: we can join the 45-minute slot on Thu 12/07 at 11:00 PT, but prefer the meeting remain focused on technical fit and commercial intent only. Please keep the first 30 minutes for AE+SE+champion+eng lead and reserve the final 15 minutes for procurement/security to ask clarifying questions.

Also: we’ve attached a short security evidence checklist (security-evidence-checklist.xlsx) we’ll use to triage whether an expedited pilot is allowed. Please confirm gross data flows and whether any customer PII will be sent to Redwood during pilot testing. If yes, include retention expectations and encryption-at-rest details.

Thanks —
Jess Carter (on behalf of Procurement)
FinTech Lab Procurement
procurement@fintechlab.com

Attachments: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Initial discovery — multi-team intake & timing check

All —

Thanks everyone for the quick sync. Let’s lock Thu 2028-12-07 11:00–11:45 PT (45 minutes) and follow Ben’s suggestion: first 30 minutes focused on AE+SE+champion+eng lead, then 15 minutes for procurement/security clarifying Qs. I’ve sent the calendar invite and included a short agenda and the checklist link for security.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123fintechlab
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5493 (DL-2028-0049)

Action items before the call:
- Mina: send a 1-page pilot scope + draft SOW (attached SOW-draft-v1.pdf) — done.
- Ben: circulate the technical agenda and integration checklist in a separate doc.
- Anya/Liam: confirm any data residency requirements and whether PII will be part of pilot.
- Procurement/Security: triage the attached checklist and flag any blocking evidence requests ahead of the call.

Looking forward — please accept the invite if you can.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf
